title: HR Assistant
description:
Our client, a pioneering autonomous aviation business operating across the defence, security and aerospace sectors, is seeking an organised and proactive HR Assistant to join its growing People team on a permanent basis. This role provides broad administrative support across the employee lifecycle and offers an excellent opportunity to develop a career in Human Resources within an innovative and fast-paced technology environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, new starter documentation and other HR correspondence
- Maintain accurate employee records within the HR Information System and personnel files
- Ensure HR documentation is completed and stored in line with company policies and GDPR requirements
- Coordinate onboarding activities, induction schedules and required new starter documentation
- Support employee changes, including promotions, salary amendments and contractual updates
- Assist with offboarding processes, exit documentation and leaver administration
- Respond to routine employee and manager queries, escalating more complex matters to the wider People team where appropriate
- Provide accurate employee data to payroll within agreed deadlines.
- Process and record Employee Benefits Administration as required.
- Responsible for management of the People Team inbox and respond and resolve queries efficiently
- Act as the first point of contact for general HR queries
- Manage the E-Learning portal for the organisation, reporting attendance and adding new starters to the system.

Job Requirements:
- Previous experience in HR Administration, HR Assistant, People Administration or a similar support role
- Strong administrative and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Experience preparing professional written documentation and employee correspondence
- Confident using Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook
- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism
- Understanding of HR processes, employment documentation and the employee lifecycle
- Experience using an HR Information System such as HiBob, BambooHR, Workday or similar
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or working towards

What Success Looks Like:
- Employment contracts and HR documentation are prepared accurately and promptly
- Employee records remain accurate, up to date and compliant
- New starters receive a positive and well-organised onboarding experience
- Managers and employees receive timely and effective HR support
- HR administration, reporting and compliance activities are delivered efficiently

Benefits:
- Opportunity to join an innovative and expanding autonomous aviation business
- Broad exposure to all aspects of the employee lifecycle
- Supportive and collaborative People team
- Professional development and career progression within HR
- Fast-paced working environment within the technology, engineering and aerospace sectors

If you are an organised HR professional with strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in developing your Human Resources career, our client would welcome your application. Apply now to join a forward-thinking team supporting the future of autonomous aviation.

title: People Assistant
description:
Liberty Recruitment Group are delighted to be working exclusively with a fantastic, well-established organisation in the search for a People Assistant to join their friendly and supportive HR team.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone looking to start their career in HR, or perhaps someone with a little HR administration experience who is keen to develop their knowledge within a collaborative and people-focused environment.

Based in Southampton or Salisbury, this is a full-time, permanent and office-based role, offering a salary of circa £25,000, depending on experience.

Key responsibilities:
- Coordinate new starter processes, including preparing welcome packs, employment documentation and delivering inductions
- Manage leaver administration, including relevant paperwork and reference requests
- Record and update absence, annual leave, flexi-time and employee benefits information
- Support the coordination of training, CPD and wider learning and development activities
- Support the recruitment team with interview coordination, CV screening and candidate administration when required
- Coordinate work experience placements and support wider employee initiatives
- Respond to employee queries, providing a friendly and professional service
- Assist with HR compliance activity, including DBS checks and GDPR requirements
- Organise regular team review meetings and provide general administrative support to the wider HR team

About you
- Previous administration experience would be advantageous, although not essential
- A genuine interest in HR and developing a career within People & Culture
- A naturally people-focused approach with strong emotional intelligence
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Professional, approachable and confident communicating with people at all levels
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Full UK driving licence, as occasional travel between offices will be required

If you're looking to take your first steps into HR, or build on your existing experience within a supportive and friendly team, we would love to hear from you!

Please get in touch with the team at Liberty Recruitment Group to find out more.

title: Resourcer
description:
Prospero Group has been successfully placing teaching and support staff for over 20 years. Our network of schools, academies, and nurseries spans the UK and international markets. Our educational services are available in a wide range of educational settings; EYFS, Primary, Secondary, Further Education, SEN, and PRUs.

Looking for a career that offers meaningful work and a chance to make a difference?

At Prospero Group, you'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships with schools and teaching staff, while also reaching for the stars in terms of targets and commission. With a supportive team environment, excellent commission rates, and plenty of room for personal growth, this is a chance to join a company that truly values its people.

Prospero Group are delighted to be recruiting a Recruitment Resourcer to join our Southampton team!

In this role you will be responsible for-
- Conducting telephone interviews with prospective candidates to establish suitability for various roles
- Advertising vacancies on job boards within company guidelines
- Sourcing candidates via social media, job boards, CV searching, and our branch network
- Working with the team to coordinate each stage from initial application through to offer of employment
- Supporting with candidate mailers
- Data entry/ administration

What we are looking for-
- Driven, hungry and motivated individuals with a 'winning' attitude!
- Willingness to learn
- Strong written and communication skills
- Positive and 'can do' attitude
- Graduate or equivalent desirable
- Competitive and target driven

Experience within a similar role is desirable.

You must be able to demonstrate a proven track record in your field, whether it be in work, education, or sport! We are always looking for individuals with the hard-working mindset that is looking to apply themselves to a new challenge.

This is a great opportunity to learn the foundations of recruitment and grow!

What We Offer:
- Industry-leading OTE
- Great holidays plus your birthday off!
- Target-based incentives and rewards
- Career progression based entirely on your personal achievement
- Opportunity to become a team leader or manager very quickly
- Industry-leading training throughout your career
- A culture that motivates, excites and stimulates
- Monthly company social events

If you're ambitious, financially motivated, competitive, and interested in joining a growing business with a group of like-minded people, then Prospero has the career you're looking for!

IND-INT

Prospero Teaching is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.
